strategies.name: opening_range_fvg_retest_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: On the 5-minute opening range, mark the high and low of the first 9:30-9:35 candle, then switch to the 1-minute chart and wait for price to break a level with a fair value gap. After price retests the fair value gap, enter only once the retest candle is engulfed in the breakout direction.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop one tick beyond the deepest point traded into the fair value gap, and take profit at a fixed 3:1 reward-to-risk target. No active management after entry.

strategies.name: opening_range_fvg_limit_reentry_day_trade
strategies.entry_summary: On the 15-minute opening range, mark the high and low of the first 9:30-9:45 candle, then switch to the 5-minute chart and wait for price to break a level with a fair value gap. Instead of waiting for confirmation on the retest, place a passive limit order on the fair value gap so entry occurs when
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop just beyond the first candle of the fair value gap pattern, and take profit at a fixed 2:1 reward-to-risk target. No active management after entry.

result.enumeration_note: The video teaches two distinct but compatible entry/exit skeletons: a scalp using retest-plus-engulfing confirmation with 3:1 target, and a day-trade using passive limit entry on the FVG with 2:1 target.
